title: Goldman Warns Oil May Rally to $120 on Ship Disruptions
description:
Samantha Dart, co-head of global commodities research at Goldman Sachs, says that gasoline and diesel prices can remain elevated into “the whole of next year” as tightness in refining capacity is not being resolved. She speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.”
